description: AICTIONBOT™ symptom navigator by KULIC Advisory (tool 46), built on the field note T36 (execution break patterns). Rate nine symptoms from 0 to 5: manual (manual work), approvals (nested approvals), visibility (no spend overview), data (wrong or duplicate data), suppliers (difficult supplier relationships), compliance (rule breaches), maverick (orders bypassing procurement), communication, breaks (system breaks). Returns per symptom, strongest first, what it typically costs, the first step for this week and the matching Workbench tools, and the matching step of the KULIC ladder with the step below and above (no prices in the answer; prices on the linked pages). has_procurement no keeps the recommendation at Signal Scan or below. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

symptoms.description: Strength per symptom from 0 (does not apply) to 5 (fully applies).
